reason: I might poke at the free plan to see which integrations it really has, but I'm not paying 99 a month to let an AI answer my customers when one wrong reply can cost me a client I spent years winning. 'Connects to your CRM' with a '...' tells me nothing about whether it plays nicely with my HubSpot and Zapier setup.
objection: An AI talking to my customers unsupervised could make promises or say something off-brand and damage my reputation, and I can't see how much control I keep over what it sends.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial where every customer-facing message needs my approval before it goes out, plus a published list of native integrations (HubSpot, Zapier/Make) and what a credit actually buys.
